project_summary: Subscription meal kit e-commerce with mobile app

components.name: Subscription billing
components.description: Weekly and monthly subscription plans with pause, skip and cancel flows, proration and recurring card payments with dunning on failures.

components.name: Delivery scheduling and routing
components.description: Delivery slot booking, capacity limits per zone and daily route export for the logistics partner.

components.name: Customer accounts with social login
components.description: Customer registration and login with email and password or Google and Apple sign-in, password reset and profile management.

components.name: React Native mobile app
components.description: iOS and Android app to browse weekly menus, manage the subscription, track deliveries and receive push notifications.
